suggested_experiment_name: Mrk 421 and Mrk 501 blazar VHE gamma-ray observations
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing chi (dimensionless), canonical dark photon coupling
notes: Paper constrains dark photon kinetic mixing ε using VHE gamma-ray observations of blazars Mrk 421 and Mrk 501. Main result: ε ∼ 10^-7 at 95% C.L. for m_D ∼ 0.03–1 eV mass range (stated in abstract and Section 5). The constraint is derived from photon-dark photon scattering absorption in the DM spike around the supermassive black hole in the blazar host galaxy, combined with IGM and Milky Way contributions. Data extracted from text statement in Section 5 and Figure 4. The two-point encoding (0.03 eV to 1 eV at ε=10^-7) represents the stated mass range over which this coupling limit applies. Confidence level is 95% as stated (Δχ² ≥ 2.71). This is an astrophysical/indirect constraint, not a direct haloscope search, so dm_density_assumed is null (the DM density is part of the astrophysical model, not an independent assumption).
